_comment: Approvals for the member Production project (splitpost-members-production). Both stay false until the founder approves them in a reviewed PR. photosApproved: whether photo posting may be switched on there (ops.media_settings.photos_enabled). invitationsApproved: whether accounts may be invited (ops.invitations), which also allows accounts other than the launch founder to hold membership. openRegistrationApproved: whether anyone may register themselves and receive membership on verifying their email (docs/OPEN-BETA.md): it allows external access (ops.member_launch_settings.external_access_approved) to be open, but never invitations. Approve it only once the privacy notice and community rules are published. Setting a flag to true does not change the database: it only allows a separately approved, recorded change. While a flag is false, supabase/tests-members/001_member_production.sql fails if the database shows the feature on, and every member workflow stops. postMediaFunctionApproved: whether the post-media Edge Function may be deployed to member Production (the avatar function is the default and only one until then); it allows the deploy only, and photo posting still needs photosApproved.
